title: MainBTB 模块语义闭环：完整分支属性中的 RAS 提示位、57 个未覆盖 arm 的逐项归因，以及既有差异的证据边界
scope: 独立 Mbtb DUT 的 30 个功能点与 120 个选测用例；不证明完整 BPU 或完整 FTQ

human_events.event: 一个真实分支反馈带有分支类型、目标、位置与 RAS 提示位（none/call/return/return-and-call）；随后从原 PC 查询。
human_events.owner: 完整分支属性属于该原始指令位置；RAS 提示位与分支类型是同一个属性字的两个字段，不是可丢弃的旁带。
human_events.effect: 预测条目与原始 metadata 都原样返回该提示位；四个提示编码各自只属于自己的位置。

human_events.event: 同一位置已有一个直接跳转；重新解码为同一位置、同一目标但带直接调用提示（仅 rasAction 0→2）。
human_events.owner: 属性修正属于原位置命中的记录，不是一次新分配。
human_events.effect: 原 way 被就地重写为新属性并恢复弱 taken 初态；邻居的 way、目标与方向不变；有效条目数仍为 2。

full_attribute: XiangShan/.../bpu/mbtb/MainBtbAlignBank.scala:225-231：t1_entryNeedWrite 在命中时还要求 needIttage 或 attribute 变化。
XiangShan/.../bpu/mbtb/Bundles.scala:67：BranchAttribute 的相等比较同时包含 branchType 与 rasAction。
因此仅 rasAction 变化就会触发原 way 的整条重写；此前所有测试向量的 ras_action 都是 0，该路径未被观察。
known_position_only_counter: XiangShan/.../bpu/mbtb/MainBtbAlignBank.scala:255-267：计数器 hitMask 只按 branch.valid & isConditional & meta.position 匹配，不检查 meta.rawHit 或 tag owner。
同位置但不同 tag 的陈旧 metadata 因此可以递减/递增另一记录的计数器；这正是 017/025/027/028 共同的首错。
参考模型只允许真实命中记录拥有方向更新；未为通过而复刻该实现分支。

closed_by_this_round.signals: RAS hint bits on training, metadata, prediction and both align-bank response paths
examples: rtl/mbtb/MainBtbAlignBank_1.sv:62/73 and the second-align-bank metadata path

uncovered_lines.source: each line is if (io_write_1_valid & io_write_1_bits_setIdx == N) states_N <= io_write_1_bits_state
uncovered_lines.classification: physical set replicas of one replacement-state update
uncovered_lines.reason: training only touches a representative set of 64 physical sets in the production profile; the physical profile intentionally sweeps coordinates. This is replica enumeration, not 49 functions. The module's own definition review already calls them replacement-state copies.

premises: MainBtbAlignBank.sv and _1.sv define s2_multiHitMask = {multiHitMask_1, 1'h0}, so flush wayMask bit zero is permanently zero for port 0
structural_proof.controls: 16 exhaustive Boolean cases plus four source mutations; each mutation is rejected by the proof
structural_proof.scope: generated two-way standalone MiniConfig hierarchy only; no denominator subtraction

toggle_remaining.note: mostly FTQ train-bundle payload that the standalone DUT does not consume, plus per-set replacer state bits and data payload bits; no functional control signal is missing

existing_failures.note: baseline and final have the identical ten failing node IDs; the two new cases pass.

position_only_counter_qualification.cause: MainBtbAlignBank.scala:256-259 qualifies the hit mask by position only, not by rawHit/tag ownership

zero_key_cleanup.cause: the conflict rule uses entry.tag == 0 with the same set index, so a joint zero tag/position clear can route the zero payload through a retained lower-way owner

shared_service_loss.cause: two real inputs find the same service owner; when the complete feedback and the first cleanup arrive in the same cycle, only the invalidation is observed and the target correction is lost

false_positive_false_negative_checks: Before this round, no test varied rasAction, so a defect that dropped the hint bits would have produced a silent false negative. The new round-trip and hint-only-rewrite cases close that blind spot; both pass, so this is positive evidence, not a new failure.

The new hint-only rewrite keeps branch type, position and target identical, so the observed update can only come from rasAction being part of the attribute comparison. A branchType-only implementation would fail the case.
The 10 failures are byte-identical to the baseline node IDs; no pre-existing verdict was rewritten, and no new XFAIL was added.
The 8 unreachable arms are proven from generated hierarchy constants with mutation negative controls, not from failing to reach them.

The 49 per-set arms are classified as replicas of one replacement-state update, matching the module's own earlier definition review; they are not counted as 49 functions and the denominator is not reduced.
Functional groups at 100% do not cover the failing semantics: the 10 failures sit in paths already counted as covered, so coverage saturation is not reported as functional PASS.
constraints: No RTL, DUT or system SDK change.
No bank/set sweep and no forged internal signals; the new cases use the public training/lookup API.
The selected run does not replace the retained full regression.
remaining: MainBTB position-only counter qualification needs an RTL fix or a specification decision; 017/025/027/028 stay FAIL.
The joint zero-key cleanup attribution needs an RTL fix or a specification decision; 029 stays FAIL.
The shared-service correction loss needs an RTL fix or a specification decision; 026 stays FAIL.
Full FTQ lifetime and composed BPU arbitration remain outside this module run.
